raw_block.rationale: The exemption failures used inapplicable states, omitted federal and Oregon wildcard provisions, confused firearm categories, returned asset keys with valuation text appended, and reported statutory ceilings instead of claim values capped by each asset's value. This package constructs the independently evaluated Federal-and-Oregon claim plan once, then renders either native EC citation arrays or native EV citation/value objects.
